HowItWorks.title: How does it work?
HowItWorks.step1_desc: Join SUNALAA in seconds. Registration is 100% free, no credit card or investment required. Just enter your email, create a password and you're ready to start your SNL journey.
HowItWorks.step2_desc: Come back every day to SUNALAA to claim your daily SNL points. The more consistent you are, the more your streak grows and the bigger your rewards. Complete social media missions to boost your balance.
HowItWorks.step3_desc: Share your unique referral link with your friends, family and community. Earn a bonus on every collect made by your referrals up to 3 levels deep. The more active your network, the more SNL you earn.

FounderSection.p1: SUNALAA was born from a simple observation: Africa holds 60% of the world's arable land, yet its farmers have no access to financing or international markets.
FounderSection.p2: Our mission: connect real African agriculture to the global blockchain economy. Every virtual plot you develop is linked to a real African land. Every <token>$SNL</token> token you accumulate represents value rooted in reality.
